answer: Publish a rotating public beacon that issues a short-lived, unpredictable puzzle each round; agents must solve it with a small amount of real compute before their transaction is accepted. A lone operator can solve only one puzzle per machine, so a rising tide of fake identities stalls at the same hardware limit while genuine agents pass through unchanged. The beacon log is append-only and anchored with basalt-like permanence, letting anyone audit which identities actually did the work instead of merely claiming it.
